entries.clue: It may have a number of seeds
1986 sequel set on the planet LV-426
Brown quickly at a high temperature
Gen. Ambrose Burnside was its first president
Not receptive to a sad story, say
Summer Games host between Barcelona and Sydney
Thor, coordinating the thunder and lightning?
Battleship that is now a Los Angeles maritime museum
Name for a squad that does a lot of traveling?
Items that can be seen on the back of a dime
Feature of many an Ogden Nash poem
Part of a florist's model of the solar system?
Gorgon working in a garment factory?
Sister of Amy, Beth and Jo
Larsen's catcher in his World Series perfect game
